label: Q.4 a.2 preexistence from containment in every cause and cause-of-being transfer
meaning: If c causes x's being and x is in act in r, the cause-of-being transfer (f8ba2429) gives that c causes x's being r; containment in every cause then gives that c is in act in r. So every perfection of a thing whose being c causes is in c (STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE). One GradesFrame: the same InAct (IN_ACT_4), CausesIn (CAUSE_2) and esse throughout. A new support option for that root-route node through the respect-wise containment hinge; both premises stay open, and the analyst containment premise is stronger than the Cartesian total-cause clause. Uniform IN_ACT_4 reading of act throughout.

strong_version_needed.f8ba2429-b4f1-5712-a4d3-798213963d34: q.4 a.2 preexistence constrains every cause of a thing's being; the weak versions restrict the cause (residual transfer 5a4afaa5 excludes universal causes, universal-cause transfer b26c10a0 covers only causes of every other being).
strong_version_needed.634a80b8-470e-4d2f-9dd0-fc868e4a62a0: q.4 a.2 preexistence covers partial causes of being; containment in total causes only (the weak version) does not constrain them, as the independence control shows.
